crossRefs.note: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward…
He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
translations.bsb: On the third day Laban was informed that Jacob had fled.
translations.kjv: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
translations.asv: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
